block_box_node.name: Block Box™
block_box_node.description: The world's first mono-material EPS cornice packaging system where the product IS the container. Block Box™ eliminates all external packaging materials through CNC hot wire cutting of multiple cornice profiles within a solid EPS block, connected by tear-away bridges. Zero cardboard. Zero plastic wrap. Zero void fill. 94% packaging waste reduction.
